<!-- version: 2.60.0 -->
If you have a monthly task or appointment that falls on the 29th, 30th or 31st, this release changes when it comes back - and it is worth reading, because until now it was quietly skipping months. A series on the 31st only appeared in seven months of the year: February, and any other month too short for that date, was left out entirely rather than moved to its last day. Series repeating every second or third month drifted out of step on top of that, because a skipped month shifted the rhythm. Such a series now lands on the last day of a short month, as it always should have. Nothing needs to be re-entered, and no database change is applied, but the next occurrence of an affected series may fall on a different day than you have been seeing.

On a phone, dragging cards around the task board no longer happens by accident. Scrolling past a card used to pick it up and could drop it in another column; now a card comes along only if you hold it briefly first, and a swipe stays a swipe. With a mouse nothing changes - a card still moves the moment you drag it.

The wall display gets a kitchen timer. Pick three, five, ten, fifteen or thirty minutes, and the remaining time stands on the wall in figures you can read across the room, with a chime at the end. It runs on the tablet itself, so it needs no connection to anything and keeps going while the rest of the page reloads; the photo screensaver stays out of the way while a timer is counting. Along with it, the wall display can now be started from the overview page, where until now it could only be left - switching it on still works from the settings as well.

Finally, a new task can be created as "in progress" or "done" straight away. The field was previously only offered when editing a task, which meant that writing down something you had already started took two steps.

Full release notes are available at https://github.com/ulsklyc/yuvomi/releases/tag/v2.60.0
